pressure_uniformity.note: equal end pressures and Graham's law keep p uniform; Newton tolerance

prefactor_v1_ratio.note: d_0/2 in both routes moves the gap by the discretisation error's change with Kn; a defect V1 sees moves it by orders of magnitude

break_eq85_prefactor_v3.note: the prefactor cancels from Graham's sum; Newton tolerance

maxwell_stefan_limit_dev.note: departure at 1 mm, a physical value near 5.4e-4 whose spread over three BLAS kernels (2.2e-3 of itself) is too large for a value claim: held to a band

maxwell_stefan_rate.note: departure from Maxwell-Stefan falls as 1/d_0 (1 mm to 10 mm)

maxwell_stefan_tol_effect.note: tenfold tighter Newton tolerance at 1 mm, relative to the departure

eq109_collapse_worst.note: 2x2 inversion against eq. (109), face by face
